dataset: UCI Online Retail II, all two sheets
cohort: customers with at least two distinct valid timestamps in both periods
split: sha256('sequence-v1:'+customer) first 8 hex digits modulo 10 < 5 for discovery; remaining for evaluation
pattern_language: sequences of singleton products; each step must have a strictly later transaction timestamp; skipped baskets permitted
primary_family: all discovery-frequent sequences of length 2 and 3; no selection using evaluation results
primary_test: two-sided exact McNemar with Benjamini-Yekutieli FDR correction, q <= 0.05
confidence_intervals: paired customer bootstrap, 2000 replicates, marginal percentile 95%, not simultaneous
sensitivities: truncate both years to minimum observed basket count for each paired customer
order_permutation: top 10 distinct-product pairs by discovery support, 499 within-customer basket-order permutations on evaluation year 2010; two-sided centered-null test; Bonferroni over ten
scope: exploratory course experiment; one retailer; no causal claim; local single-machine pipeline
